owns.description: HTTP edge for /webhook/*, /form/*, /webhook-test/*, waiting routes: method guard, CORS, route matching, response modes
invariants: W1 only DELETE GET HEAD PATCH POST PUT + OPTIONS accepted; others 500 'The method X is not supported.'
W2 OPTIONS answered 204 (CORS preflight), never executes
W3 findWebhook: exact match first, else dynamic by webhookId longest-pathLength wins
W4 unknown path 404 'The requested webhook ... is not registered.' + production hint
W5 known path wrong method 404 'This webhook is not registered for GET requests...'
W6 (webhookPath, method) unique; taken path raises WebhookPathTakenError with exact message
W7 default responseMode onReceived -> 200 {'message':'Workflow was started'}
W8 invalid responseMode -> 'The response mode 'x' is not valid!' (500)
W9 n8n-auth/n8n-browserId cookies stripped unless node in authAllowlistedNodes
W10 test webhooks: in-memory, single-shot, 120s timeout; waiting-webhook finished/unknown execution 409/404

items.artifact: node webhook() impl + node-level auth eval
